description:
Refactor TV Platform Code into Separate File Pattern

Implement a platform-specific file pattern to separate TV platform code from the main codebase, eliminating conditional platform checks and creating a clean abstraction layer.

Requirements:
- Create parallel file structure with .tv extension for all TV-specific implementations
  - .tsx files → .tv.tsx files
  - .ts files → .tv.ts files
  - Apply pattern to other file types as needed (.css, .json, etc.)
- Extract all TV-specific logic from existing files into corresponding .tv.* files
- Remove all conditional checks for TV platform (e.g., if(isTVPlatform), platform === 'tv', etc.)
- Implement a module resolution strategy that automatically loads .tv.* files for TV platform
- Ensure the abstraction maintains type safety across platform variants
- Keep shared logic in base files, only TV-specific overrides in .tv.* files
- Update build configuration to handle the new file pattern
- Document the pattern for future development

Success criteria:
- Zero platform conditional checks remain in the codebase
- All TV-specific behavior is isolated in .tv.* files
- Base files contain only shared/default platform logic
- Build system correctly bundles appropriate files per platform
- No duplicate code between base and TV files for shared functionality
title: Implement platform-specific file pattern for TV codebase separation
